name: DocsHeader
title: Templates/Headers/DocsHeader
summary: The documentation bar: a `GlobalHeader` in its default `content` placement, so it runs full bleed across the window and opens on the page boundary. Start: the navigation trigger below `lg`, the brand with the Docs tag, and the section links from `lg`. End: search, GitHub, then Console. Search leads the end cluster in every channel, so it sits at the start of the buttons wherever the reader is. The sample widens the search into a field carrying the ⌘K shortcut once the bar is wide enough; the control is an icon button below that, and an icon button here. Built from `GlobalHeader`, `NavigationMenu`, `IconButton`, `Button` and `Brand`.
